facts.note: Nine o'clock temple bell, watches shown; hers exact, doctor's two minutes ahead, Girard would not take his out. The extra remark that the master commented on Girard is colour, not a time or whereabouts.

Hall clock struck ten when regulator showed 12 to ten; master's habitual remark about that clock; regulator agreed with the temple bell at ten exactly. The 'old joke' and 'particular' comments are colour.
Sent downstairs when regulator showed twenty past ten; regulator running and master well; went straight to the kitchen.
Saw the master in the kitchen that afternoon with Rosa's clock in his hands, laughing; did not ask why.
Looked at Rosa's clock when Madame's piano began: two minutes to eleven. When piano stopped: eleven minutes past eleven.
Stayed in the kitchen with Rosa until after the temple struck eleven.
